body.p: Embodiments of the present disclosure include a method and apparatus for using a

virtual prop, a device, and a storage medium, relating to supporting virtual environments. The method includes: displaying a user interface rom a first visual character's perspective; in response to a use instruction, controlling the first visual character to use a first virtual prop to generate a defense range an attack from another virtual prop; and intercepting the second virtual prop based on determining that the another virtual prop will likely fall within the defense range of the first virtual prop.
